name: shotgun-shared
description: Shared code imported by the Expo app, the Vercel API (server/), and scraper scripts. Owns its own dependencies because Node resolves imports upward from the importing file - server/node_modules is a sibling, not an ancestor, so nothing under shared/ can see it. The Vercel project root is server/, so only server/ gets `npm install` during builds; server's postinstall installs this package's deps to keep shared/ self-contained.
